messages:
anya: new prototype: compact-row layout where p50/p95 sparklines sit above a small density mini-map. idea: mini-map acts as scrubbable overview for keyboard users. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/compact-row-minimap.png
josh: nice. question: when p95 overlaps p50 line in tight ranges we lose the p95 marker. can we add a stacked marker or offset?
rachel: maybe offset vertically by 4px when overlap detected. keep that subtle. also add tooltip `p95 (sampled)` when sampling present.
praveen: backend note: some customers compute p95 on sampled streams; we must avoid implying it's exact. tooltip should read: "p95 (estimated from sampled data)"
anya: good catch. we'll add conditional copy. rachel: quick copy tweak: change "estimated" to "approximate"? sounds less alarming.
josh: UX: mini-map scrubber needs keyboard + screen reader support. propose left/right arrows move the scrub by bucket, and Home/End snap to view edges.
rachel: on keyboard focus, announce `Scrubber at 10-20s window of 5m range` via aria-live. make sure it doesn't spam on small increments.
praveen: perf note: moving scrubber will trigger sampling requests. debounce to 150ms and show a spinner on the mini-map thumb during fetch.
anya: animation: thumb movement should be immediate, but content fade can be 80ms. respect prefers-reduced-motion.
josh: color contrast: mini-map low-intensity blues are fine, but hovered bucket outline must be 3px and use neutral-900 for clarity on light themes.
rachel: accessibility nit: shift+arrow should expand selection window. we need to document keyboard mappings in the tooltip and keyboard help modal.
design-bot: Reminder: analytics returns sample_rate float and sample_source enum (agent/server). UI must show source when available e.g., "sampling: 1-in-20 (5%), client-sampled".
praveen: auditability: when user pins a scrub position we should log action with route and timestamp. ops requested this for replay debugging.
anya: small copy idea for the metric legend: "p50 (median) • p95 (95th percentile; approximate if sampled)". feedback?
josh: I like explicitness. one more: collapse long legend into a `?` tooltip on mobile.
rachel: QA checklist for PR: keyboard nav, ARIA announcements, scrubber debounce, sampler copy states, overlap marker offset, reduced-motion behaviors.
anya: great. I'll refine mock with offset markers and updated copy, then open PR with screenshots + QA checklist. tagging @josh @rachel @praveen for review :sparkles:
